query.description: Search issues. Adapters pass through provider-specific flags.

create.description: Create an issue. Labels must already exist provider-side.

begin.description: Move issue to 'work in progress' state. Provider-side state name comes from adapter's state-mapping.

finish.description: Move issue to 'done' state, attaching the evidence file as a comment. Errors if --evidence is missing.

comment.description: Append a comment without changing state.

close.description: Move to 'done' without evidence. Use for stale/duplicate/won't-fix. The evidence-gate hook will block this verb if used in a change-flow context where evidence is required.

cancel.description: Move to 'cancelled' state. Optional; adapters may exit 3 if provider has no cancel state.

prefix.description: Print the configured issue ID prefix (e.g. 'VI'). Used by audit-trail hooks to derive the trailer regex without hardcoding.

pattern.description: Print a regex that matches valid issue IDs (e.g. 'VI-[0-9]+'). Used by hooks and CI gates.

verify.description: Run provider-side preflight: validate auth, team/project existence, labels, workflow states. Exit 0 if all checks pass, 1 if recoverable, 2 if fatal.
